criteria.criterion: Every rule of `.loop/check-brief.sh` is ported with the same problem/warning split and the same message wording
criteria.evidence: internal/brief/check.go Check() covers journal (.vloop path), worked example, fence, out-of-scope + count, constraints, task count, exit codes, home paths incl. Windows, symbols, path resolution outside Binding references, tracker keys/URLs; check_test.go TestRules asserts each message

criteria.criterion: Only briefs with frontmatter `status: ready` are checked; others print path and skipped line
criteria.evidence: Check() skips when Status != ready; cli/brief.go prints '- skipped: status is <status>'; TestSkipUnlessReady, TestBriefCheckSkipped

criteria.criterion: Headings match the configured language's heading set, case-insensitively, trailing text allowed; English set is product data in a non-test file
Output per brief: root-relative path, marker lines, summary; final line; exit 0 iff no problems
criteria.evidence: cli/brief.go runBriefCheck; Problem(errors.New("")) with root.go silencing empty message; TestBriefCheckTextAndExit

criteria.criterion: Missing path / not a loop brief / no path behaviours and exit codes
criteria.evidence: suffix validation loop runs before any check and returns error; MinimumNArgs(1); missing prints 'vloop: no such brief' and counts failed; TestBriefCheckUsageAndMissing

criteria.criterion: --json prints exactly one document with the specified shape
criteria.evidence: briefJSON/struct field order ok,briefs / path,result,problems,warnings; empty slices non-nil; TestBriefCheckJSON

criteria.criterion: Committed fixtures: for every ported rule a passing and a firing brief, exercised by committed tests in scratch repos
criteria.evidence: testdata/en/pass.loop-brief.md plus per-rule mutations in TestRules and TestPassesForEachRule using t.TempDir repos

criteria.criterion: Tests never read `.loop/check-brief.sh` or anything under `.loop/`
criteria.evidence: grep of internal/brief and cli/brief*.go finds only a scratch-repo .loop/state/journals directory created in a temp dir to prove it is ignored

criteria.criterion: gofmt clean, go vet passes, builds for linux, windows and host
criteria.evidence: gofmt -l . empty; driver gate log and go test pass; work session reported verify exit 0

notes: T4 should make SetFor strict rather than falling back to English. root.go change (silence empty error message) is a small, justified supporting edit. Fixtures are one file plus in-test mutations rather than paired files; adequate.
